title: Write Playwright E2E test: landing page generation
description: Write Playwright E2E test for the landing page generation flow. Tests that clicking 'Generate All Pending' runs generation and updates statuses.
acceptanceCriteria: E2E test file exists at tests/e2e/generation.spec.ts
Test creates a batch with at least 1 prospect programmatically via API
Waits for status to change to 'ready' (with timeout of 120 seconds)
Verifies Preview link appears for the prospect

steps.details: In `tests/e2e/generation.spec.ts`: use Playwright's request fixture to POST /api/batches (create batch) and POST /api/prospects (create 1 prospect with a real business URL). Store batch id and slug.
Navigate to /batches/[id]. Verify 1 prospect with status='pending'. Click 'Generate All Pending'. Wait for status badge to show 'ready' (poll up to 120s). Verify Preview link is visible.
After each test, DELETE /api/batches/[id] to clean up test data.
Run `npm run test:e2e tests/e2e/generation.spec.ts`. Test passes (requires valid ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in .env.local).

technicalNotes: This test requires a real ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to run against the live AI service.
Mark this test with `test.slow()` to extend its timeout.
